svg.title: The same total, different structure
svg.desc: Copy, unique and exclusive-or gates all have joint mutual information ln 2 but different redundancy, unique and synergy atoms under shared exclusions, Williams-Beer I_min and BROJA.

g.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Source Sans 3', 'Latin Modern Math', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: a dot marks a zero atom
Each gate has I(S1, S2; T) = ln 2. Atoms: MGW exactly, Imin in closed form, BROJA by optimization.
